### PYQ_T3_01: Select the CORRECTLY matched pair regarding connective tissue:

- A) Tendon — Specialised connective tissue
- B) Adipose tissue — Dense connective tissue
- C) Areolar tissue — Loose connective tissue
- D) Cartilage — Loose connective tissue

> **✅ Answer:** C) Areolar tissue — Loose connective tissue
> **Explanation:** Areolar and Adipose are Loose Connective Tissues; Tendon is Dense Regular CT; Cartilage is Supportive CT.

### PYQ_T3_02: Which of the following cell types secretes histamine, serotonin, and heparin in loose connective tissue?

- A) Fibroblasts
- B) Histocytes
- C) Mast cells
- D) Plasma cells

> **✅ Answer:** C) Mast cells
> **Explanation:** Mast cells produce histamine (inflammatory mediator), heparin (anticoagulant), and serotonin.
